Allow webmapdata_editor to see all rows.name: Allow webmapdata_editor to see all rows

Allow webmapdata_editor to update webmap.name: Allow webmapdata_editor to update webmapdata column

Enable read access for all users.name: Enable read access for all users

users_public_username_unique.name: users_public_username_unique
users_public_username_unique.where: nullif(btrim("users"."username"), '') is not null and "users"."username" !~ '[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+' and lower(btrim("users"."username")) is distinct from lower(btrim("users"."wallet"))

artist_interview_boundaries_wording.name: artist_interview_boundaries_wording
artist_interview_boundaries_wording.value: char_length(btrim("artist_interview_boundaries"."wording")) > 0 AND char_length("artist_interview_boundaries"."wording") <= 4000 AND char_length("artist_interview_boundaries"."origin_question_key") between 1 and 500 AND char_length("artist_interview_boundaries"."origin_question") between 1 and 8000

artist_interview_evidence_valid.name: artist_interview_evidence_valid
artist_interview_evidence_valid.value: "artist_interview_question_evidence"."ordinal" between 1 and 3 AND "artist_interview_question_evidence"."memory_snapshot_id" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof("artist_interview_question_evidence"."evidence_references") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("artist_interview_question_evidence"."evidence_references") between 1 and 3 AND char_length("artist_interview_question_evidence"."evidence_references"::text) <= 16000

artist_interview_sessions_state.name: artist_interview_sessions_state
artist_interview_sessions_state.value: "artist_interview_sessions"."sitting" > 0 AND (("artist_interview_sessions"."state" = 'active' AND "artist_interview_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("artist_interview_sessions"."state" = 'finished' AND "artist_interview_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL))

artist_research_candidates_destination.name: artist_research_candidates_destination
artist_research_candidates_destination.value: "artist_research_candidates"."destination" = 'lore' OR ("artist_research_candidates"."destination" = 'link' AND "artist_research_candidates"."platform" IS NOT NULL AND "artist_research_candidates"."platform_id" IS NOT NULL)
